Appended 15 universality enhancement tasks across 6 phases (UNIV-P0 through UNIV-P6). Phase 0: common standard agnostic; Phase 1: tiered templates; Phase 2: agent parameterization; Phase 3: enforcement generalization; Phase 4: skill consolidation; Phase 5: script enhancement; Phase 6: registry update.

UNIV-P6-O completed: Added 4 new tech debt entries (TD-2026-008 through TD-2026-011) to TECH_DEBT_REGISTRY.md; Updated skill-invocation-standard.md §3.1 §4: deprecated nextjs-router-guardrails → fullstack-ci-cd-guardrails, deprecated prisma-seed-cicd → cicd-database-seeding, registered new cicd-database-seeding skill. Added 2026-05-21 @Architect裁决记录.
All 14 UNIV tasks marked completed. Full universality enhancement implementation done.

Appended 11 framework repair tasks (FW-REPAIR-01 through FW-REPAIR-11) based on @Architect Architecture Report (.task_temp/architect-inspection/ARCHITECTURE_REPORT.md). Covers P0 (template_resolution, contract.yaml, machine.schema.json, state cleanup), P1 (keystone_hashes, template engine, reset script, gate-state sync), and P2 (cross-workspace protection, path fix, template variable standard).
